limitations: The theorem excludes ordinary codimension-one Filippov sliding/escaping regions but does not classify degenerate common tangencies. Saltation statements require transversal crossings. The result does not establish periodic-orbit existence or stability and does not classify the Hopf bifurcation. It applies to arXiv:2607.18140v1 as formulated.
provenance: Scientific derivation from the cited threshold-controlled dengue model; review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
